data.title: Arknights: Endfield Now on GeForce NOW – FAQ
data.brief: Dear Endministrator:Arknights: Endfield is now available on the NVIDIA GeForce NOW cloud gaming plat
data.data:
Dear Endministrator:

Arknights: Endfield is now available on the NVIDIA GeForce NOW cloud gaming platform. You can play the game without downloading the full client to your local devices. Game progress will remain synchronized across all devices and platforms, allowing for a seamless continuation of your journey.

Below are some frequently asked questions you may encounter while playing on GeForce NOW. We hope these are helpful to all Endministrators.


How do I play Arknights: Endfield on GeForce NOW?

Q: How do I play Arknights: Endfield on NVIDIA GeForce NOW?

A: You can simply search for Arknights: Endfield in the NVIDIA GeForce NOW client or web version and click [Play] to start.

※ To check if NVIDIA GeForce NOW is supported in your country or region, please visit the GeForce NOW FAQs:

https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/faq/


What devices can I use?

Q: Which devices support Arknights: Endfield on NVIDIA GeForce NOW?

A: NVIDIA GeForce NOW members can play via the client on Windows PC, Mac, and Chromebook, or use the web version through Chrome or Edge browsers on PC, macOS, and Chromebook devices.

※ To check if your device supports NVIDIA GeForce NOW, please refer to the NVIDIA GeForce NOW system requirements here:

https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/system-reqs/


Do I need a Gryphline Account?

Q: I don't have a Gryphline Account. Can I play Arknights: Endfield on NVIDIA GeForce NOW?

A: If Endministrators do not yet have a Gryphline account, you can register for one after launching the game via the NVIDIA GeForce NOW client or web version. Gryphline Accounts registered this way can also be used on other platforms. If you already have a Gryphline account, simply log in after launching the game, and your account data will synchronize automatically.


Which servers are supported?

Q: Which servers does Arknights: Endfield support on NVIDIA GeForce NOW?

A: Endministrators can log into Arknights: Endfield and access the Asia Server and Americas / Europe Server on NVIDIA GeForce NOW.


Is game progress shared?

Q: Will my game progress synchronize with other platforms when playing on NVIDIA GeForce NOW?

A: Yes. When playing Arknights: Endfield on NVIDIA GeForce NOW, your data is shared across different devices and platforms within the same server. Any progress you make will be saved as usual and synchronized across all platforms.


Can I purchase in-game items on NVIDIA GeForce NOW?

Q: Can I make in-game purchases (like bundles or Origeometries) while playing Arknights: Endfield on NVIDIA GeForce NOW?

A: In-game purchases are fully supported on NVIDIA GeForce NOW. Endministrators can make purchases as usual, and the payment process is the same as on other platforms. Items obtained through in-game purchases will also be synchronized across all platforms.


Where do I get help if I encounter issues while playing?

If you encounter any in-game issues, please use the [Settings - Platform & Account - Contact Customer Support] option in-game to contact us. For any other questions, you can also reach us at endfield_cs@gryphline.com. Please include any relevant details so we can assist you further.

If you have questions about NVIDIA GeForce NOW membership or supported devices, or if you encounter issues like poor network connectivity, please consult the NVIDIA GeForce NOW customer support team or visit http://nvidia.custhelp.com/app for more information.
